info.title: Fuse JSON-RPC Specification
info.description: A specification of the Fuse execution JSON-RPC API provided by Chain.Love platform.

methods.name: clique_discard
methods.description: This method drops a currently running proposal. The signer will not cast further votes (either for or against) the address.

params.name: address
params.description: Address to discard from voting proposals.

methods.name: clique_getBlockSigner
methods.description: Retrieves the signer of the block with the given hash. Returns an error if a block with the given hash does not exist.

params.name: blockHash
params.description: Hash of the block to retrieve the signer for.

methods.name: clique_getSigners
methods.description: Retrieves the list of authorized signers.

params.name: blockNumber
params.description: Block number or tag to get the list of signers for. Optional, defaults to latest block.

methods.name: clique_getSignersAnnotated
methods.description: Retrieves the list of authorized signers but with signer names instead of addresses.

params.name: blockNumber
params.description: Block number or tag to get the annotated list of signers for. Optional, defaults to latest block.

methods.name: clique_getSignersAtHash
methods.description: Retrieves the list of authorized signers at the specified block by hash.

params.name: blockHash
params.description: Hash of the block to get the list of signers for.

methods.name: clique_getSignersAtHashAnnotated
methods.description: Retrieves the list of authorized signers at the specified block by hash but with signer names instead of addresses.

params.name: blockHash
params.description: Hash of the block to get the annotated list of signers for.

methods.name: clique_getSignersAtNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the list of authorized signers at the specified block by block number.

params.name: blockNumber
params.description: Block number or tag to get the list of signers for.

methods.name: clique_getSnapshot
methods.description: Retrieves a snapshot of all clique state at a given block.

params.name: blockNumber
params.description: Block number or tag to get the snapshot for. Optional, defaults to latest block.

methods.name: clique_getSnapshotAtHash
methods.description: Retrieves the state snapshot at a given block.

params.name: blockHash
params.description: Hash of the block to get the snapshot for.

methods.name: clique_produceBlock
methods.description: Forces Clique block producer to produce a new block.

methods.name: clique_proposals
methods.description: Retrieves the current proposals the node is voting on.

methods.name: clique_propose
methods.description: Adds a new authorization proposal that the signer will attempt to push through. If the vote parameter is true, the local signer votes for the given address to be included in the set of authorized signers. With vote set to false, the signer is against the address.

params.name: address
params.description: Address to propose for inclusion or removal from authorized signers.

params.name: vote
params.description: Vote for inclusion (true) or exclusion (false) of the address.

methods.name: debug_deleteChainSlice
methods.description: Deletes a slice of a chain from the tree on all branches.

params.name: blockNumber
params.description: Block number from which the chain slice should be deleted.

params.name: count
params.description: Optional number of blocks to delete starting from blockNumber.

methods.name: debug_getBadBlocks
methods.description: Returns a list of invalid blocks.

methods.name: debug_getBlockRlp
methods.description: Retrieves a block in the RLP-serialized form.

params.name: blockNumber
params.description: Block number or tag to retrieve the RLP for.

methods.name: debug_getBlockRlpByHash
methods.description: Retrieves a block in the RLP-serialized form.

params.name: blockHash
params.description: Hash of the block to retrieve the RLP for.

methods.name: debug_getChainLevel
methods.description: Retrieves a representation of tree branches on a given chain level.

params.name: level
params.description: Chain level to retrieve the branch representation for.

methods.name: debug_getConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves the Nethermind configuration value, e.g. JsonRpc.Enabled.

params.name: key
params.description: Name of the Nethermind configuration parameter to retrieve.

methods.name: debug_getRawBlock
methods.description: Returns the raw block in serialized format.

params.name: blockNumber
params.description: Block number or tag to retrieve the raw block for.

methods.name: debug_getRawHeader
methods.description: Returns the raw block header in serialized format.

params.name: blockNumber
params.description: Block number or tag to retrieve the raw block header for.

methods.name: debug_getRawReceipts
methods.description: Returns raw receipts in serialized format.

params.name: blockNumber
params.description: Block number or tag to retrieve the raw receipts for.

methods.name: debug_getRawTransaction
methods.description: Returns the raw transaction in serialized format.

params.name: txHash
params.description: Hash of the transaction to retrieve in raw format.

methods.name: debug_getSyncStage
methods.description: Retrieves Nethermind sync stage with extra metadata.

methods.name: debug_insertReceipts
methods.description: Insert receipts for the block after verifying receipts root correctness.

params.name: blockNumber
params.description: Block number or tag to insert receipts for.

params.name: receipts
params.description: Array of raw receipts to insert for the block.

methods.name: debug_migrateReceipts
methods.description: Sets the block number up to which receipts will be migrated to.

params.name: blockNumber
params.description: Block number up to which receipts will be migrated.

methods.name: debug_resetHead
methods.description: Updates / resets head block - use only when the node got stuck due to DB / memory corruption.

params.name: blockHash
params.description: Hash of the block to which the current head should be reset.

schema.description: 32-byte block hash as a 0x-prefixed hex string.

methods.name: debug_standardTraceBadBlockToFile
methods.description: This method is similar to the debug_standardTraceBlockToFile method, but can be used to obtain information about a block that has been rejected as invalid.

params.name: blockHash
params.description: Hash of the invalid block to trace. This method is intended for obtaining trace output for a block that was rejected as invalid.

schema.description: 32-byte block hash as a 0x-prefixed hex string.

params.name: options
params.description: Tracing options controlling which execution data is collected and how the trace is produced.

disableMemory.description: If true, excludes memory from trace output.

disableStack.description: If true, excludes stack data from trace output.

disableStorage.description: If true, excludes storage data from trace output.

enableMemory.description: If true, includes memory in trace output.

stateOverrides.description: Optional per-address state overrides applied during trace execution.

balance.description: Account balance override as a hex-encoded integer.

code.description: Contract bytecode override as 0x-prefixed hex data.

movePrecompileToAddress.description: Address to which a precompile should be moved for the trace.

nonce.description: Account nonce override as a hex-encoded integer.

state.description: Complete storage override map keyed by 32-byte storage slot.

additionalProperties.description: 32-byte storage value as a 0x-prefixed hex string.

stateDiff.description: Partial storage override map keyed by 32-byte storage slot.

additionalProperties.description: 32-byte storage value as a 0x-prefixed hex string.

timeout.description: Optional trace timeout value as a duration string.

tracer.description: Name of the tracer to use.

hasValue.description: Indicates whether a tracer configuration value is present.

txHash.description: Optional transaction hash to trace only a specific transaction within the block.

params.description: Hash of the block to trace. The trace is written to file for the specified transaction, or for all transactions in the block if no transaction hash is provided in the options.

methods.name: debug_traceCall
methods.description: This method lets you run an eth_call within the context of the given block execution using the final state of parent block as the base. The block can be specified either by hash or by number. It takes the same input object as a eth_call. It returns the same output as debug_traceTransaction.

params.name: call
params.description: Call object describing the message call to trace.

to.description: Recipient address. Omit for contract creation.

gas.description: Gas limit supplied for the call as a hex-encoded quantity.

gasPrice.description: Legacy gas price as a hex-encoded quantity.

maxFeePerGas.description: Maximum total fee per gas for EIP-1559 style calls.

maxPriorityFeePerGas.description: Maximum priority fee per gas for EIP-1559 style calls.

value.description: Amount of wei transferred with the call as a hex-encoded quantity.

data.description: ABI-encoded input data as a 0x-prefixed hex string.

input.description: ABI-encoded input data as a 0x-prefixed hex string. Alternative to `data`.

nonce.description: Account nonce as a hex-encoded quantity.

address.description: Address included in the access list.

storageKeys.description: Storage keys included for the address.

items.description: 32-byte storage slot as a 0x-prefixed hex string.

chainId.description: Chain ID as a hex-encoded quantity.

blockHash.description: Optional block hash associated with the call object.

blockNumber.description: Optional block number associated with the call object as a hex-encoded quantity.

hash.description: Optional transaction hash associated with the call object.

transactionIndex.description: Optional transaction index as a hex-encoded quantity.

methods.name: debug_traceTransaction
methods.description: This method will attempt to run the transaction in the exact same manner as it was executed on the network. It will replay any transaction that may have been executed prior to this one before it will finally attempt to execute the transaction that corresponds to the given hash.

params.name: transactionHash
params.description: Hash of the transaction to trace. The transaction is replayed in the same context in which it was originally executed.
